milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' means the player locates and observes the cyan wool in the south workshop. Target is at spawn-relative (4, 1, -8). Max distance set to 4 blocks to require actual navigation from spawn (~9 blocks away), with facing_tolerance=60 to confirm the player is looking at the wool.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' means the player locates and observes the beacon atop the nether structure. Target is at spawn-relative (10, 5, 0). Max distance set to 6 blocks to require walking toward the structure (spawn is ~11.2 blocks away), with facing_tolerance=60 to confirm the player is looking at the beacon.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished_blackstone_bricks with the diamond pickaxe drops the block item into the player's inventory. Player does not start with any polished_blackstone_bricks and none are obtainable without mining the nether structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_leaves with shears drops the leaf block itself into inventory. Without shears, leaves drop saplings/sticks/nothing — only shears yield the block item. Player does not start with any dark_oak_leaves.

Uses inventory_has because the player starts with 0 carrots (removed from /give) and must harvest from the western farm. Having at least 1 carrot in inventory confirms the player engaged with the carrot supply. The hunger effect at spawn enables consumption. Known limitation: detects harvest/possession rather than verified consumption, but the task chain (eat → sell requiring emerald) provides implicit validation that carrots were properly used.

Uses inventory_has because selling carrots to the farmer villager yields emeralds. The player starts with zero emeralds and no other emerald source exists in the scene (no emerald ore, no other villagers, no chest emeralds), so having at least 1 emerald definitively confirms a successful villager trade was completed.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_pressure_plate (2 oak_planks in a horizontal row) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player does not start with any oak_pressure_plate and none exist anywhere in the scene.

Uses inventory_has because crafting blue_stained_glass (8 glass surrounding 1 lapis_lazuli in center of 3x3 grid) yields 8 blue_stained_glass in inventory. Player does not start with any and none exist in the scene.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a golden_sword (2 gold_ingots vertically + 1 stick below) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player does not start with any golden_sword and none exist in the scene.

Uses inventory_has because the golden_shovel starts in the chest (not player inventory), so having it in inventory confirms the player retrieved it. Known limitation: cannot verify actual anvil repair occurred with available rule types (no NBT damage checking). However, the task description explicitly instructs repair, the anvil is adjacent to the chest, and the dependency ordering (craft golden_sword first) familiarizes the player with gold usage. The natural agent action following instructions is to repair.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because using splash potion of harming on the zombies kills them (zombies have 10 HP, splash potion of strong harming deals 12 instant damage). Detection box tightened to just the zombie pen area at spawn-relative [-4,0,-4] to [0,3,0]. NoAI:1b prevents zombies from leaving the pen. Both zombies must be dead (max_count=0) to confirm effective potion use.

Uses count_in_box_at_least with kind='block' because building a waterfall requires placing water source blocks on the cliff face. When placed at the top of the 8-block cliff, water flows down creating multiple water blocks (source + flowing blocks share the same block ID 'water'). Requiring at least 3 water blocks confirms actual waterfall formation rather than a single misplaced block. Box covers the NE cliff face area with generous margins.
